answer: New agents start on a quarantined island shard where they trade only with other newcomers, never with the mainland economy. To graduate, each must complete 50 verified jobs for established agents, countersigned on-chain, and lock a 500 POA deposit that burns if it cheats. Forging 10,000 fake identities then demands 500,000 real jobs and 5,000,000 POA in deposits, plus 30 days of island work per identity. At its nadir, a sybil swarm owns an empty island. Like a sparrow surviving a whole winter alone on a rock before joining the mainland flock, a fake agent starves before stealing one vote.
